title: Start here
description: Begin with the ordinary: a mosquito net, an unhurried day, a conversation with time. Then follow a poem, a journey, or a page from college.

posts.note: Ghosts have rules too. A mock-serious guide to surviving the night from inside a mosquito net.
Time drops by, gets trapped in an Excel cell, and stays for an unhurried afternoon.
A visit home to Lucknow, unhurried afternoons, and a fan that decides when the day begins.
Kaalu disappears when college calls, returns whenever home does, and leaves one last surprise at the door.
Kumbhakarna and Vibhishana meet between the claims of family, duty and conscience.
Returning to unread books feels a little like finding old friends—and an earlier self.

groups.title: Follow the rain and the trail

posts.note: Meghalaya, Meghdoot beside a lake, a curious cat, and a journey with an unexpected ending.
A night expedition with ten-rupee torches, fireflies, and a trail that keeps everyone guessing.
A promised beach, a forest full of leeches, and a destination with other plans.
A college-era contest, a lot of golgappas, and the confidence to turn a snack into a sporting event.
